name: triage
context_rationale: Interactive: asks mode/risk questions one at a time and engages with each answer, picks mode collaboratively, and writes project-open artifacts. Needs the live user conversation, so it cannot be delegated to a fresh-context subagent.
summary: Greenfield AI SDLC project opener. Picks the pipeline mode (Minimal / Standard / Heavy) via interactive Q&A (or accepts a pre-declared mode), builds the initial reversibility-tagged risk register, writes the thin vault skeleton (triage.json, risk-register.json, decisions/, spikes/, slices/) plus a small project-root CLAUDE.md, optionally installs code-review-graph integration, and tells the user the mode-specific next step. Re-runnable for mid-project re-scoping. Greenfield only — routes substantial existing codebases to /adopt.

methodology_tools.name: risk_register_audit
methodology_tools.purpose: Validates the risk register written in Step 5 (required fields, valid values, scoring/sorting per RR-1).

external_tools.name: code-review-graph
external_tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — installs the Claude Code MCP integration (30 MCP tools + slash commands + git hooks); builds/refreshes the code graph. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
external_tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Load-bearing — structured-options Q&A for mode selection, risk questions, and the code-review-graph-install / git-init prompts.

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Re-triage detection (read existing triage.json), reading existing CLAUDE.md before append.

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Write triage.json, risk-register.json, vault skeleton dirs, project-root CLAUDE.md.

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Step 0 preflight detection and the optional code-review-graph install commands.

file_access.purpose: Re-triage detection (Step 1) — read existing mode + risks to update rather than overwrite.
Triage snapshot: mode, classification, rationale, pipeline path, deferred steps, initial risk snapshot.
Running risk ledger, one RR-1 block per risk; validated by risk_register_audit.
Heavy mode only — empty comprehensive-vault dirs pre-created for compliance (components/contracts/actors/test-plan/frontend/schemas).
Step 5b — read to decide fresh-create vs append.
Project-root pipeline-enforcement file (created fresh or appended). STAYS MARKDOWN in v2 — Claude Code reads it natively.

file_access.path: code-review-graph integration (MCP tools + git hooks + .code-review-graph/ store)
file_access.purpose: Step 5b-pre, opt-in. Installs the always-on code-review-graph integration.

name: discover
context_rationale: Interactive, one-topic-at-a-time conversation that engages with each answer, pushes back on scope, and co-derives the first slice candidate from the dialogue. Needs the live user conversation, so it cannot be delegated to a fresh-context subagent.
summary: Discovery step of the AI SDLC pipeline. Runs after /triage. Interactive concept + users + tech-constraints exploration in one unified loop, one topic at a time: WHAT (concept, scope, non-goals), WHO (actors with top actions, needs, boundaries), CONSTRAINTS (stack/infra/team, reversibility-tagged). Addresses HIGH-risk items, optionally records external references as JSON fields, and names the first slice candidate. Writes mode-scoped outputs: concept.json (all modes); tech-decision ADRs (Standard); requirements.json + per-actor files (Heavy).

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Structured-options prompts for the one-topic-at-a-time WHAT/WHO/CONSTRAINTS conversation, the HIGH-risk spike question, and the external-references ask.

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Prerequisite check (read triage.json for mode + risks); read risk-register.json HIGH items.

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Write concept.json (all modes); tech-decision ADRs (Standard); requirements.json, actors/<actor>.md (Heavy); update risk-register.json.

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Step 4.5: record external references as JSON fields (multimodal ingest dropped in the code-review-graph->CRG swap).

file_access.purpose: Prerequisite check — read the mode (controls what discover produces) plus audience/risks.
Step 3 — read HIGH-risk items to ask which can be spiked before designing.
Update the existing register with discovery-phase risks.
1-page brief: What/Who/Constraints + named first slice candidate.
One ADR per non-trivial tech decision, reversibility-tagged. Not produced in Minimal mode.
Functional + non-functional requirements. Heavy mode only.
One file per actor with role-play walkthroughs. Heavy mode only.
Materialize the named first slice candidate into the unified candidates backlog.
